summary: Backend regression for Buried Treasure Steps 2 (Group Notification Toggle) + 3 (Smart Availability / Awake-Hours Filter). Built /app/backend/tests/test_bt_schedule_toggle.py with 16 focused pytest cases against the deployed public URL. Result: 16/16 PASSED. Every spec'd behaviour verified: /api/bt/schedule GET returns {schedule:{awake_start, awake_end, sleep_all_day, timezone, updated_at, is_default}, is_awake_now}; POST persists values + is_default flips to false; sleep_all_day=true forces is_awake_now=false even with a valid window saved; garbage HH:MM ('not-a-time') coerces silently to 08:00/23:00 defaults with 200 status (no 500); wrap-around windows (22:00->06:00) accepted; invalid IANA tz drops silently without rejecting save. Group toggle: POST /bt/groups/{id}/toggle returns {ok:true,enabled:bool}, persists into bt_group_prefs, surfaces in GET /bt/groups/prefs as a {group_id:enabled} map, round-trips ON->OFF->ON correctly; non-member returns 403; non-existent gid returns 404. is_active_now is server-computed and now serialized on every group payload from /bt/groups/mine and /bt/groups/available (verified isinstance bool); /bt/groups/available still returns 200 with the field present even when admin's schedule is sleep_all_day=true. Regression: /bt/settings, /bt/solo/current, /bt/groups/mine all still 200. Backend logs clean throughout the run — no tracebacks, no 500s. The previously-validated rewrite suite (test_buried_treasure_v2.py, 34 tests) remains untouched.
action_items: Optional: /app/backend/buried_treasure.py is now ~1230 lines (well over the 700-line module budget). Strongly consider splitting into bt_solo.py + bt_groups.py + bt_schedule.py + bt_shared.py before adding more features.

Optional UX nit: /bt/schedule POST with `sleep_all_day=True` still persists the awake_start/awake_end values sent alongside it, so a later POST with sleep_all_day=False restores them. Confirm with PM whether that's intended (it currently is, and it's the friendliest behaviour).
critical_code_review_comments: Schedule validation is correctly defensive: _parse_hhmm returns None on bad input and the route coerces to (8,0)/(23,0) — never 500s on garbage. Good.

_is_group_active_now uses a per-member round-trip to bt_group_prefs + bt_player_schedule + profile.timezone — for a group with many accepted members this is O(N) DB calls per available-list render. Acceptable for current group sizes but flag if groups grow into the hundreds (consider a single batched $in lookup).
buried_treasure.py is now ~1230 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Functionally fine, but a split is overdue.
GET /bt/schedule includes `updated_at` even when no doc exists (will be null); the `is_default` boolean is the canonical signal — frontend should use that, not the presence of `updated_at`.
